judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Curt gatekeeper line, chatty favour-for-sponsorship bargain, the apple orchard with a foul little urchin who aggravated the bats, and a ruby key handed over all match the Dun Mir sponsorship errands in tone and detail; the run-on commas and plain refusal line read like shipped campaign text.
